BackstoryDef.title: planet jumper
BackstoryDef.description: After being extracted from the Grey Planet from their successful extermination mission. [PAWN_nameDef] was given extra training to enhance [PAWN_possessive] combat skills. \nNow [PAWN_pronoun] has been sent to the Rimworld to help clear out the unchipped population there.

BackstoryDef.title: pacifist medic
BackstoryDef.description: Despite the scientist's best efforts, [PAWN_nameDef] refused to engage in violence, even to defend [PAWN_possessive]self. However, instead of being disposed of, one scientist figured out that [PAWN_pronoun] could serve as a medic in an extermination squad. \nWhile [PAWN_nameDef] hates combat, [PAWN_pronoun] would rather render medical aid than continue being tortured or executed by the scientists.

BackstoryDef.title: uncaring opportunist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was delighted when [PAWN_pronoun] was informed that [PAWN_pronoun] will be deployed as part of an extermination squad. Being part of an extermination squad meant that [PAWN_pronoun] would be treated vastly better should [PAWN_pronoun] succeed. \n[PAWN_nameDef] is unsure why the other experiments would object to an opportunity such as this.

BackstoryDef.title: shrewd follower
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was quick on the uptake when the scientists started acting more weird than normal. Being a fan-favorite amongst the scientists due to [PAWN_possessive] fast learning, [PAWN_nameDef] knew that something went wrong on the Grey Planet, and that [PAWN_pronoun] was going to be deployed. \nWithout the strength to avoid being deployed, [PAWN_nameDef] stay in wait for an opportunity to escape.

BackstoryDef.title: trapper specialist
BackstoryDef.description: Sensing a gift inside [PAWN_nameDef], [PAWN_possessive] assigned scientist trained [PAWN_objective] in the art of fabricating traps. While just a test of intellect at first, once the Company started needing ground troops to clear out unchipped colonies, [PAWN_nameDef] was deployed to put [PAWN_possessive] skills to use.

BackstoryDef.title: designated backpack
BackstoryDef.description: Seemingly incapable of most tasks. The scientists found it fit that [PAWN_nameDef] would be used as a way to increase the carrying capacity of a squad.

BackstoryDef.title: backstabbing charmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s job was simple. [PAWN_pronoun] would reach out with settlements that have come in contact with other sawians and gather information from them. Once [PAWN_pronoun] got all the information [PAWN_pronoun] needed. [PAWN_possessive] squad would eliminate the settlement. Nobody was to know of the existance of the sawians. \nDue to [PAWN_nameDef] importance, [PAWN_pronoun] was modified to be more appealing, though [PAWN_pronoun] gained a bit of an ego through this.

BackstoryDef.title: drug testbed
BackstoryDef.description: To test if combat stimulants would improve the survival rate of extermination sawians, the scientists subjected [PAWN_nameDef] to extensive drug testing. \nDespite their initial expectations, [PAWN_nameDef] was extremely receptive to the testing, super eager each time they went to pickup [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: corporate snitch
BackstoryDef.description: To reduce the number of sawians who abandon the extermination mission, [PAWN_nameDef] was instructed to monitor [PAWN_possessive] squadmates for disloyalty and report it to the company. \nAny sawian who were reported about by [PAWN_nameDef] only found out after their head starts beeping.

BackstoryDef.title: moving target
BackstoryDef.description: To increase the accuracy of the chipped soldiers being deployed, [PAWN_nameDef] and a few others were selected by the scientists to serve as live moving targets. The effectiveness of the program was designated inconclusive and the ethics board soon cracked down on it. \nDespite expecting a bit of a respite after the program's termination, [PAWN_nameDef] found [PAWN_possessive] being deployed instead.

BackstoryDef.title: fall guy
BackstoryDef.description: To test the effectiveness of the Turbulent crystal shard at reducing fall impacts, the scientists decided to use [PAWN_nameDef] by having [PAWN_objective] fall from ever increasing heights.

BackstoryDef.title: unremarkable soldier
BackstoryDef.description: After growing up, [PAWN_nameDef] was about as unremarkable as a sawian could be. [PAWN_pronoun] woke up on time, participated with the experiments with no fuss, eat [PAWN_possessive] meals, and then went to sleep. \nThis demeanor didn't change once [PAWN_pronoun] was selected to be deployed.

BackstoryDef.title: field cook
BackstoryDef.description: Despite being deployed with food rations, deployments often ran out of food before getting the chance to be extracted. \nTo reduce the number of fatalities due to starvation, [PAWN_nameDef] was taught how to scavenge food, butcher animals, and cook to feed [PAWN_possessive] unit.

BackstoryDef.title: backseat observer
BackstoryDef.description: Tasked by a particular scientist, [PAWN_nameDef] works undercover obtaining intelligence on the state of the unchipped colonies, silently reporting it back to the scientist.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel diver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loved being underground so much that the other scientists took note. [PAWN_possessive] affinity towards navigating narrow passageways and dark places made [PAWN_objective] the optimal choice for searching for unchipped colonies on the Grey Planet.

BackstoryDef.title: disgraced pet
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] used to be the personal pet of one of the upper-level scientists. However, one day the scientist abandoned [PAWN_objective] and tossed[PAWN_objective] back with the other sawians. \nWhile [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't know what [PAWN_pronoun] done wrong, the other sawians didn't forget seeing [PAWN_nameDef] being showered with affection.

BackstoryDef.title: silent assassin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s job was very simple. Assassinate anyone that The Company™ tells [PAWN_objective], even if it one of [PAWN_possessive] squadmates.

BackstoryDef.title: warmonger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was tasked to use [PAWN_possessive] social skills to keep morale high amongst [PAWN_possessive] squadmates. Encouraging others to stay on the mission and to eliminate any unchipped saws.

BackstoryDef.title: combat engineer
BackstoryDef.description: To fufill the need for someone with demolition experience in the field, the company trained [PAWN_nameDef] on how to use explosives and shore up shelters for [PAWN_possessive] combat team.

BackstoryDef.title: uncaring medic
BackstoryDef.description: Compared to the other medics being deployed, [PAWN_nameDef] isn't too worried about mental wellbeing of [PAWN_possessive] patient's mental health. Gleefully ripping shards out at max speed, and carelessly bashing limbs back into its socket.

BackstoryDef.title: firebug
BackstoryDef.description: After being subjected to combat training, [PAWN_nameDef] gained a sudden obsession with fire, attempting to start fires at seemingly random. \nDue to [PAWN_nameDef]'s antics, [PAWN_pronoun] was deployed prematurely so the scientists could get rid of [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: torturer
BackstoryDef.description: While the unchipped are offering the location for their safety, The Company™ will not accept this deal. To ensure the location of The Cargo is found, [PAWN_nameDef] and some others have been selected to use more "specialized" methods to extract information from survivors.
